isolated_native_Tk.scope: switching, persisted drafts, profiles, floating editor, narrow layout, registration, confirmed apply and cancelled apply

AI_foundation_in_isolated_Linux.skip_reason: source-checkout-without-manifest case is inapplicable in an actual generated package

limitations: Per-game writable controls require a reviewed adapter and pack, not merely a catalog entry.
Generic INI and multi-game writes were tested on disposable fixtures; real Shadow settings were read only.
Manager handoff is prepared files, not native deployment or profile migration.
An existing running Hub loads the new page on its next normal restart; user draft windows are preserved.
AI tool discovery in a diagnostic client does not prove a running chat has reloaded its tool catalog.
No game launch, benchmark, capture, save mutation, graphics-profile activation or neural-rendering experiment was performed.
private_evidence: Retained outside Git and OneDrive; machine bindings, source provenance, package hashes and recovery receipts are separate.
